items.author: Gabriel Flores
items.caption: pearl at dusk. the ground fountains lit up, trees wrapped in string lights, a kid and a dog losing their minds in the spray, the old brewery chimney behind it all. saturday ritual. free to walk, $12 tacos if you cave #sanantonio #thepearl

note.description: an outdoor plaza at dusk with colorful illuminated ground fountains spraying water onto wet pavement, trees wrapped in string lights, and people including a child and a dog nearby. a tall brick chimney with partial 'pearl' lettering rises behind the trees and buildings.

items.author: Lena Schultz
items.caption: took my out of town cousin to the river walk against my will. dusk is the only acceptable time: stone bridge, trees lit purple and green, a boat with red lights way down the water. still not a fan but I get it for 20 minutes. go eat at the pearl after, don't eat down here

note.description: a river at dusk with stone walls and a stone bridge, trees lit in purple and green, and people walking along the paved path on the right. a boat with red lights is visible in the distance on the water.

comments: Tyler: 'against my will' and then you post the prettiest photo of it. the river walk won
Gabriel: don't eat down here is the most important sentence on this app. pearl or southtown, nothing else

items.author: Gabriel Flores
items.caption: mission san josé with abuela on a cloudy sunday. the long wall of stone arches, two rows, green bushes in front, weathered like it's been there 300 years because it has. free. national park. she lit a candle and then made me drive her to h-e-b. spare room in southtown is open, she WILL cook for you

note.description: a weathered stone building with two rows of arches under a cloudy sky, with green bushes in the foreground.

comments: Maya: the arches are so good. also 'she will cook for you' is the strongest hosting pitch in the network
Lena: abuela's food vs the pearl food hall. abuela, every time

items.author: Raj Iyer
items.caption: the banh mi on bellaire. $4.50. shredded pork, pickled carrots, cucumber sticks, a fistful of cilantro, on paper like it should be. this is the first stop on my official night market tour (the tour is me, driving you, for free). guest room in montrose has a ridiculous number of towels, come use them

note.description: a close-up of a banh mi sandwich on white paper, filled with shredded meat, shredded carrots, cucumber sticks and fresh cilantro.

comments: Maya: $4.50 and a fistful of cilantro. you had me at the paper wrapper
Priya: the tour is 'me driving you for free' is the most raj thing ever. I'm in for thanksgiving week
Yara: the one two doors down has a better baguette and I'll fight you

items.author: Layla Haddad
items.caption: the saturn v lying down in its hangar is the whole museum for me. stages stretched out on black supports, the burnt capsule at the front, info signs on fake grass. it's like $30 to get in which is steep but the rocket alone is worth 20 of it. sundays I'm usually at the museum district instead, half those are free

note.description: a huge saturn v rocket lying horizontally on black supports inside a large hangar, with its weathered capsule at the front and white and yellow stages stretching back. it sits on a raised platform with artificial grass and info signs, under a high metal roof.

comments: Omar: a rocket on its side is a materials science lecture I'd actually attend. visiting next month, we're going

items.author: Harper Nguyen
items.caption: big tex standing over the cacti with his arms out like he's about to hug 100k people. cotton bowl behind him, texas flag, the whole fair. fletcher's corny dog is $10 now which is a crime but I paid it. go on a weekday, parking's $25 on weekends, ride the dart instead, $6 all day

note.description: a giant cowboy statue with arms outstretched stands over cactus plants and a small crowd under a blue sky. behind it are a tall tower, a texas flag, and a building marked cotton bowl.

comments: Cole: $10 corny dog and you still went back for a second. I saw you
Owen: dart is the move. we did it from the vintage market in oak cliff and it was easy
Maya: big tex looks so pleased with himself. plano kids forever

items.author: Cole Patterson
items.caption: deep ellum on a sunday afternoon when it's quiet. the overpass pillars painted like trees, then actual trees and grass in the little park past them, brick buildings behind. nobody's out yet. truck's in the lot, spare bedroom in lower greenville's empty, come up

note.description: a sunny street corner under a highway overpass with large pillars painted with green trees, real trees and grass in a small park area beyond, and brick buildings in the background.

comments: Harper: sunday afternoon deep ellum is the only deep ellum I'll do
Maya: the painted pillars next to the real trees is kind of a perfect dallas joke. coming up for a plano reunion soon?
Kenji: the truck seats 5 and I'm one of them. marfa in december

items.author: Grace Liu
items.caption: sienna made brunch at hers and then we walked to the park downtown with the food trucks lined up on the lawn and the glass towers behind. january so the trees were bare but it was 65 out bc texas. $9 for a second lunch from the trucks because brunch is a personality but so is a snack

note.description: a sunny park lawn with bare trees, green tables and chairs, and several food trucks in the foreground, with tall glass skyscrapers rising behind under a clear blue sky.

comments: Sienna: brunch at mine then food trucks is the official uptown weekend. come back when the trees have leaves
Hannah: second lunch is a budget line item I respect
Tyler: which trucks. I'm up there for a closing next month

items.author: Gabriel Flores
items.caption: pearl at dusk. the ground fountains lit up, trees wrapped in string lights, a kid and a dog losing their minds in the spray, the old brewery chimney behind it all. saturday ritual. free to walk, $12 tacos if you cave #sanantonio #thepearl

note.description: an outdoor plaza at dusk with colorful illuminated ground fountains spraying water onto wet pavement, trees wrapped in string lights, and people including a child and a dog nearby. a tall brick chimney with partial 'pearl' lettering rises behind the trees and buildings.

items.author: Lena Schultz
items.caption: took my out of town cousin to the river walk against my will. dusk is the only acceptable time: stone bridge, trees lit purple and green, a boat with red lights way down the water. still not a fan but I get it for 20 minutes. go eat at the pearl after, don't eat down here

note.description: a river at dusk with stone walls and a stone bridge, trees lit in purple and green, and people walking along the paved path on the right. a boat with red lights is visible in the distance on the water.

comments: Tyler: 'against my will' and then you post the prettiest photo of it. the river walk won
Gabriel: don't eat down here is the most important sentence on this app. pearl or southtown, nothing else

items.author: Gabriel Flores
items.caption: mission san josé with abuela on a cloudy sunday. the long wall of stone arches, two rows, green bushes in front, weathered like it's been there 300 years because it has. free. national park. she lit a candle and then made me drive her to h-e-b. spare room in southtown is open, she WILL cook for you

note.description: a weathered stone building with two rows of arches under a cloudy sky, with green bushes in the foreground.

comments: Maya: the arches are so good. also 'she will cook for you' is the strongest hosting pitch in the network
Lena: abuela's food vs the pearl food hall. abuela, every time
